fields.label: Title
fields.description: A name for this connection, e.g. "Production PostgreSQL". Shown when picking stores on a cluster.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: What the cluster uses this store for. Data: settings, directory and message metadata. Blob: message bodies and attachments. Search: full-text index. In-Memory: caches, rate limits and cluster coordination.

The backend. Data: PostgreSql, MySql, RocksDb (single node only). Blob: Default (inside the data store), S3, FileSystem, PostgreSql, MySql. Search: Default (inside the data store), ElasticSearch, Meilisearch, PostgreSql, MySql. In-Memory: Default (inside the data store), Redis, RedisCluster, RedisSentinel. A multi-node cluster needs PostgreSql/MySql data and a Redis in-memory store.

fields.label: Host
fields.description: Hostname or IP of the database server.

fields.label: Port
fields.description: Leave blank for the default: 5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL.

fields.label: Database
fields.description: Name of the database Stalwart stores everything in. It must exist already; Stalwart creates the tables.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: Login user. Optional for Redis Cluster and Sentinel.

fields.label: Password
fields.description: Password of the login user.

fields.label: Use TLS
fields.description: Encrypt the connection to the database. Turn on for managed databases reached over the internet.

fields.label: Pool Recycling Method
fields.description: How a pooled PostgreSQL connection is checked before reuse. fast: no check; verified: ping; clean: ping and reset session state.

fields.label: Pool Min Connections
fields.description: Connections MySQL keeps open even when idle.

fields.label: Max Allowed Packet
fields.description: MySQL max_allowed_packet in bytes. Leave blank for the server default; raise it if large messages fail to store.
Extra key=value options appended to the PostgreSQL connection string, e.g. sslmode=require.
fields.label: Options
Path
fields.description: Directory on the node where the files live. Only usable by single-node clusters and egress gateways because the data is not shared.

fields.label: Blob Size
fields.description: RocksDB stores blobs smaller than this many bytes inline; larger ones go to the blob store. Default 16834.

fields.label: Buffer Size
fields.description: RocksDB write buffer in bytes. Default 128 MB.

fields.label: Pool Workers
fields.description: Background threads RocksDB uses. Leave blank to let it pick.

fields.label: Depth
fields.description: How many nested directory levels file names are spread over. 2 is fine for millions of files.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Bucket region, e.g. ap-south-1. Any value works for services that ignore regions.

fields.label: Bucket
fields.description: Bucket name. Create it beforehand; Stalwart does not create buckets.
Leave empty for AWS. Set the API URL for MinIO, Garage, Backblaze, Hetzner and other S3-compatible services.
fields.label: Endpoint
Key Prefix
fields.description: Prefix added to every object key, e.g. blr-1/. Lets several clusters share one bucket.

fields.label: Access Key
fields.description: Access key ID of a user allowed to read, write and delete in the bucket.

fields.label: Secret Key
fields.description: Secret access key paired with the access key.

fields.label: Verify After Write
fields.description: Read every object back after writing it. Safer but doubles requests; turn off for trusted providers under load.

fields.label: URL
fields.description: Full URL of the server, e.g. https://search.example.com:9200 for ElasticSearch, http://meili:7700 for Meilisearch, redis://user:password@redis.example.com:6379 for Redis.

fields.label: Replicas
fields.description: Copies of each ElasticSearch shard. 0 on a single server.

fields.label: Shards
fields.description: Shards the ElasticSearch index is split into. 3 suits most setups.

fields.label: Include Source
fields.description: Keep the full message text in ElasticSearch as well as the index. Uses much more disk; only needed for highlighting.
Seconds between checks of a Meilisearch task's progress.
fields.label: Poll Interval
Fail On Timeout
fields.description: Treat a Meilisearch task that exceeds the timeout as failed instead of assuming it finished.

fields.label: HTTP Auth
fields.description: How Stalwart authenticates to the search server.

fields.label: HTTP Username
fields.description: Username for Basic authentication.

fields.label: HTTP Password
fields.description: Password for Basic authentication.

fields.label: HTTP Bearer Token
fields.description: Token sent as a Bearer header, e.g. the Meilisearch master key.
One redis:// URL per line: every cluster node, or every sentinel.
fields.label: URLs
Sentinel Service Name
fields.description: Name of the master as known to the sentinels.

fields.label: Protocol Version
fields.description: Redis wire protocol. resp3 needs Redis 6 or newer.

fields.label: Read From Replicas
fields.description: Let reads go to cluster replicas, which spreads load but may return slightly stale data.

fields.label: Sentinel Username
fields.description: Username for the sentinels themselves, when they differ from the master's.

fields.label: Sentinel Password
fields.description: Password for the sentinels themselves.
Seconds to wait for a request before giving up. Defaults: databases 15, S3 and search 30, Redis 10.
fields.label: Timeout
Allow Invalid Certificates
fields.description: Accept self-signed or expired TLS certificates. Only for testing.

fields.label: Max Retries
fields.description: How often a failed request is retried. S3 default 3; Meilisearch default 120 task polls.

fields.label: Pool Max Connections
fields.description: Most connections one node keeps open to this store at once.
Seconds allowed to open a new Redis connection.
fields.label: Pool Timeout Create

fields.description: Seconds to wait for a free Redis connection when the pool is exhausted.
fields.label: Pool Timeout Wait

fields.description: Seconds allowed to reset a Redis connection before it is reused.
fields.label: Pool Timeout Recycle
